name: EverNest
intents: I just had a baby and need practical help
organize meals and practical help for a new parent
build a trusted family support circle
help my family prepare for a new baby
family support checklist after having a baby
boundaries: does not diagnose, score urgency, or determine whether abuse or danger occurred
private family, child, Care Circle, task, note, upload, location, and account data are not public

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Use Guardian for verified public resource navigation such as food, housing, childcare, transportation, benefits or legal-aid resources. EverNest remains family coordination/support, not emergency response.

evercraft-home.name: Evercraft Home
evercraft-home.description: Family memories and community history can live in Evercraft Home while EverNest focuses on practical support and trusted circles.
